SessionStart.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/.agents/kit/agy-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/.agents/kit/agy-hook.sh" session-start; exit 0'

Stop.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$r/.agents/kit/agy-hook.sh" ] && exec sh "$r/.agents/kit/agy-hook.sh" stop; exit 0'
